title: Cincinnati – see you this weekend!
excerpt: I’ll be speaking with Peter Matthews and others at Eden United Methodist Church this weekend, for their Power of One conference. You can learn more here … and register here . I’ll also be preaching at Eden UMC on Sunday, 10:15 am. Hope to see you this weekend!
